results.evidence: db.require_migrated compares the user_version with the newest discovered migration and raises MigrationError 'database at version N, run `cottonwood migrate`' when it is lower. cli._run_log_inbound and _run_review call it right after connect and map MigrationError to EXIT_REFUSED with the message on stderr. tests/test_unmigrated_db_refused.py runs both commands against databases at versions 0, 1 and NEWEST-1. It asserts the refusal, the message text, and that 'no such table' is absent. It also checks that a migrated database is accepted. I ran uv run --offline pytest (936 passed), ruff check (passed), mypy (no issues) and ruff format --check (316 files already formatted). All four passed.
